resources.string: A monthly limit per expense category, and how close this month is to it.
Give an expense category a monthly limit, and this screen shows how close the month is to it.
A budget is set on an expense category. Create one first, in Settings › Categories.
What counts is what went out of each category this month, plus its subscriptions still due before the month ends. Amber from 80 %% of the limit, red once it is over.
%1$s spent and about %2$s to come, of %3$s
Each expense category can have one budget.
To move this limit to another category, delete it and set a new one.
Every expense category already has a budget.
That could not be saved. Its category may have been deleted meanwhile.
The limit goes. Nothing you have recorded changes.
